objectives: Explain Jira's core concepts: projects, issues, issue types, fields, workflows and boards
Choose the right issue type for a piece of work
Create a well-structured story in Jira with description, AC and links
Write basic JQL queries to find work

terminology.definition: An Atlassian tool for planning, tracking and reporting work, widely used by Agile teams.
A short prefix used in all issue IDs in a Jira project, e.g. GYM in GYM-42.
A single item of work in Jira, such as a story, task or bug (also called a work item).
The category of an issue: Epic, Story, Task, Bug or Sub-task.
The set of statuses and transitions an issue moves through.
Jira Query Language, used to search for issues with precise conditions.
A saved JQL search that can be shared or used on boards and dashboards.
A subdivision of a project, such as a module or system area, used to group issues.

exercises.question: Write a JQL query to find all unresolved bugs in project SHOP with priority High or Highest, newest first.
exercises.answer: `project = SHOP AND type = Bug AND priority in (High, Highest) AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY created DESC`

exercises.question: List the fields you would fill in when creating a story, and what you'd put in each.
exercises.hint: Think summary, description, AC, parent, links.
exercises.answer: **Summary** (short user-focused title); **Description** (user story text plus context); **Acceptance criteria** (numbered or Gherkin); **Parent/Epic**; **Priority**; **Labels/Components**; **Attachments/links** (wireframes, Confluence pages); **Linked issues** (dependencies). Story points are added by the team in refinement.

exercises.question: A developer logs 'Login broken on iPhone' as a Story. What's wrong and why does it matter?
exercises.answer: It should be a **Bug**: it describes something not working as intended. Correct issue types keep bug reports, quality metrics and prioritisation accurate.

quiz.question: In issue ID GYM-42, 'GYM' is the:
quiz.explanation: The project key prefixes every issue ID in that project.

quiz.question: Which issue type groups many stories delivered over several sprints?
quiz.explanation: Epics are large bodies of work containing stories.

quiz.question: A workflow in Jira defines:
options: Statuses and transitions an issue moves through
quiz.explanation: Workflows model the life cycle of an issue.

quiz.question: JQL is used to:
quiz.explanation: Jira Query Language builds precise searches and filters.

quiz.question: Which is a common BA mistake in Jira?
options: Creating stories with only a one-line summary
quiz.explanation: A summary alone doesn't give the team enough to build or test.

interview.question: How have you used Jira?
interview.answer: Creating and refining epics, stories and bugs; writing descriptions and acceptance criteria; linking stories to epics and dependencies; prioritising the backlog with the PO; using boards to track sprints; and building JQL filters and dashboards for reporting. **If you lack work experience, mention a practice project you set up in a free Jira account.**

interview.question: What makes a good Jira story?
interview.answer: A clear user-focused summary, a description in user story format with context, testable acceptance criteria, a parent epic, links to supporting material like wireframes or Confluence pages, dependencies linked, and an estimate from the team. It should meet the team's Definition of Ready before entering a sprint.

interview.question: How would you find all stories in an epic that don't yet have acceptance criteria?
interview.answer: If AC is a custom field: `parent = GYM-1 AND type = Story AND "Acceptance Criteria" is EMPTY`. If AC is in the description, use a label such as needs-ac and query `parent = GYM-1 AND labels = needs-ac`. Save it as a filter and review it before refinement.

assignment.title: Set up a Jira practice project
assignment.brief:
Create a free Jira Cloud account (or simulate one in a spreadsheet if you can't).

Create a Scrum project for a library app. Add 2 epics, 8 stories with full descriptions and acceptance criteria, 1 task and 1 bug. Link stories to epics and add one dependency link. Write 3 JQL filters useful for a BA.
deliverables: Screenshots or export of the backlog
